correctness.rationale: Images of generators split into independent positive-degree branch coordinates. The nilpotency and zero-product equations reduce to two pairs (u,v) with \(v^N=uv=0\) in \(k[t]/(t^M)\). For \(b=\lceil M/N\rceil,\ldots,M-1\) their field-point loci form an irredundant union of affine M-spaces \(L_b=\{\operatorname{ord}(u)\ge M-b,\ \operatorname{ord}(v)\ge b\}\). Taking their product proves every geometric component and its dimension; counting by exact valuation b gives \(q^{M-1}[1+(M-\lceil M/N\rceil)(q-1)]\) per branch. The Nakayama tangent criterion and \(xy=0\) distinguish diagonal/antidiagonal automorphism components for equal lengths >=3; direct enumeration over F2,F3,F4 corroborates 13 cases. The checker reconstructs the original quotient multiplication for the documented cases and agrees on all exact solution counts; all-field assertions are proved independently.

value.rationale: The unital endomorphism variety is a natural invariant of a truncated nodal Artinian algebra. Giving all geometrically irreducible reduced components and their dimensions, the complete q-point count uniformly in both nilpotency lengths, and the exact density of automorphisms reveals full-dimensional noninvertible strata invisible from automorphism-group classification. The equal-length density tends to \(2/(d-1)^2\) as q grows, a structural boundary absent from the group theory.
